title: Side navigation, calmer creation, and safer cleanup
notes: Redesigned: Swipe from the left edge for the new side navigation, with animated section changes and no bottom bar.
Redesigned: Add Homework is now a calm three-step flow that starts with only the title and course.
Improved: Tap Feedback is one simple on/off setting with a stronger spring-like response.
New: Removed homework stays in a recoverable archive for seven days; completed work remains separately restorable.
New: A One UI-compatible home-screen widget shows due-today, overdue, upcoming, and next-homework information.
Improved: Export every active assignment to the native calendar at once; local JSON backup controls were removed.
